<p align="center"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ronaldoyosua2-droid/rimworld-mod-updater/main/docs/banner.png" width="320" alt="ModSync Update"></p>

**ModSync Update** is an Android app that checks and updates your Steam Workshop mods right on your phone, no PC needed. It is built for players running **RimWorld** through RimDroid and **Project Zomboid (B42)** through Zomdroid: scan every mod in one tap, download only the files that changed, and keep your mod folders in sync with the Workshop.
